title: Pocket Service Card v1
description: Descriptor stored on-chain in Service.metadata.card. Two audiences: consumers deciding how to call a service, and node runners deciding what to run. The chain enforces size only; every field here is an owner assertion.

rpcTypeName.description: On-chain RPCType enum name. Lowercase it to get the RelayMiner rpc_type_service_configs key.

rpc_types.description: Transports. Consumers read what exists; node runners read what the owner expects them to stand up.

required.$comment: Deliberate exception to the ignore-unknown-keys rule. `required` is not an unknown future key, it is a known-wrong one: it implies an enforcement layer that does not exist. Use `intent` instead.

intent.description: The service owner's INTENTION for this transport, enforceable by nothing. Not checked at stake time, not checked at relay time, and consumers may ignore it: a supplier serving only a subset is valid and paid normally, and a gateway may decline to route a transport. Open vocabulary; unknown values mean unspecified, never invalid.

apis.description: Higher-level API contract names. Deliberately unregistered.

kind.description: Open vocabulary. Known values: openrpc, openapi, asyncapi.

sha256.description: Presence is a statement: the owner pins this exact document and consumers MUST reject non-matching content. Absence declares a living document with no integrity claim.

access.description: Open vocabulary. Known values: public, gated.

results.description: Are two suppliers interchangeable for the same request? 'deterministic' means any supplier returns the same bytes, so a consumer can retry across suppliers, cache, and cross-check. 'variable' means suppliers legitimately differ (e.g. each brings its own model). Open vocabulary; unknown values mean unspecified, never invalid.

registry.description: Resolvable pointer, e.g. a CAIP-10 style address.

serving.description: Everything a node runner needs to stand up a backend for this service.

backend.description: What data node or service this proxies to.

implementations.description: Known-good backend implementations and minimum versions.

sync.description: Open vocabulary. Known values: archive, full, pruned.

healthcheck.description: Self-test a backend before staking. Also the natural probe for a QoS layer.

request.description: Transport-shaped probe: a JSON-RPC envelope, or {path, method} for REST.
